Hi Chahana, thank you. I’ve completed the check-in form and I’ll complete the security deposit payment shortly.

I’m already on my way and I’ll arrive around 2 PM. If early check-in is possible, that would be great. If not, no problem, I can wait. I just want to confirm if I can leave my luggage at the front desk until check-in.

Could you also please send me a photo of the building and the entrance so I can easily find it?

Regarding the vehicle, I’ll be renting a car, so I’ll send you the vehicle details as soon as I receive it.
